purpose: Determine whether early MLP writes M0--M3 or later MLP writes M4--M7 form the embedding--MLP and attention--MLP source interactions that causally create MLP8's Task14 response.

parents.finding: The cross response is mostly an additive earlier-MLP signal, whereas roughly half the quadratic response is embedding--MLP or attention--MLP interaction. Embedding--attention and three-way interactions are small.

novelty_audit.relation: This prior experiment split MLP depth at the later pre-attention-11 current-value input. It did not intervene on raw writer sources at MLP8 input or preserve the newly measured embedding--MLP and attention--MLP interactions.
The canonical Task14 dossier contains MLP8 localization but no early-versus-late MLP writer factorial at MLP8 input.
The equality-circuit dossier closes native-product retuning and reconstruction/rank sweeps. This experiment selects no product coordinates and evaluates task behavior causally.

data.row_builder: unchanged fresh matched-natural Task14 HOLDOUT rows
data.disclosure: Rows and all parent E/A/M outcomes are open. Only the M0--M3 versus M4--M7 refinement and its outcomes are prospective.

exact_input_partition.E: propagated embedding/skip through block 8, including the fixed numerical remainder
exact_input_partition.closure: The raw pre-MLP8 state is exactly E+A+U+V before native MLP8 RMSNorm.
exact_input_partition.corner: For each subset of E,A,U,V, take donor values for listed source families and recipient values for the remainder, then run native RMSNorm.
exact_input_partition.operational_limit: These are native writer-family path interventions, not a unique semantic residual-stream basis.

conditions.opposite_number: 15 nonempty E/A/U/V subsets times exact cross, quadratic, and full MLP8 response
conditions.same_number_lexical: the same 15 subsets and response pieces
conditions.downstream_background: standalone fixed L11H3 interface; every other MLP4--M10 slot remains recipient

causal_statistics.set_function: For every response piece and task metric, measure the complete 2^4 source set function on CE and answer-directed margin.
causal_statistics.mobius: Compute every singleton and higher-order finite causal interaction over E,A,U,V.
causal_statistics.parent_closure: Regrouping U+V must reproduce every parent M, EM, AM, and EAM corner at the raw state, normalized input, MLP8 output, propagated slot, and downstream outcome.
causal_statistics.interpretation: Task-level terms include RMSNorm and downstream nonlinear interactions; they are not activation reconstruction or a linear attribution.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_parent_closure: All numerical gates pass and regrouping U+V exactly reproduces the parent E/A/M factorial.
predictions.pred_b_V_late_dominant: Terms containing V recover at least 70% of each parent M, EM, and AM aggregate in both metrics and directions, while corresponding U-only terms recover at most 25%.
predictions.pred_c_U_early_dominant: The converse dominance criterion holds for U.
predictions.pred_d_distributed_depth: Both U- and V-containing refinements recover at least 25% of at least one parent M-centered aggregate in both metrics and directions, and neither depth family dominates.
predictions.pred_e_cross_depth_composition: Terms containing both U and V account for at least 25% of a parent M-centered aggregate in both metrics and directions.
predictions.pred_f_direction_switch: An identified dominant depth family differs between plural-to-singular and singular-to-plural.
predictions.pred_g_number_specific: Every same-number lexical corner is at most 25% of the corresponding opposite-number full-source response scale.
